objective: Before publishing dsh-vision 0.2.0, add and fully validate a packaged npx lifecycle CLI for dsh-plugin-image-mind so users can install, update, inspect status, and uninstall the plugin with one command while all Harness mutations remain delegated to official DeepSeek Harness lifecycle commands. Keep package versions at 0.2.0, rerun release/package gates after the CLI changes, and leave one unmerged Draft PR for ChatGPT review. Do not publish, tag, create a GitHub Release, or touch the user's real Harness.
context: The 0.2.0 candidate passed Batch 017 against exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 including real browser acceptance, and Batch 018 publication preflight passed before this CLI feature was requested. main is currently the source of truth. The root README only documents raw official DSH add/remove commands and dsh-plugin-image-mind currently has no npm bin entry, so `npx dsh-plugin-image-mind install|update|status|uninstall` does not exist yet. This feature must be implemented by Codex in one batch. The CLI is a convenience wrapper, not an alternate package manager: it must discover/use only supported official DSH plugin lifecycle commands from exact rc.2, must never hand-edit Harness profile/config/lock/store files, and must use task-owned isolated Harness state for acceptance. Publication remains unauthorized until this batch is accepted and a fresh post-change preflight is green.
forbidden_changes: npm publish, npm unpublish, npm deprecate, npm dist-tag mutation, Git tag creation/push, GitHub Release creation, or any registry write
changing @ran-sh/dsh-vision or dsh-plugin-image-mind versions away from 0.2.0
installing/enabling the candidate in the user's real Harness or reading/modifying the user's real Harness profile/settings/credentials/node_modules/store/cache/lockfiles
directly editing Harness-owned profile manifests, cordis composition, package-manager lockfiles, pnpm store, settings or credentials as an implementation strategy
implementing a second package manager or bypassing official DSH plugin lifecycle commands when an official command exists
printing, reading or committing npm tokens, API keys, OTP values, cookies, auth headers, private paths or credential material
unsafe orphan cleanup: uninstall must not remove @ran-sh/dsh-vision or another shared dependency when it is still referenced by another installed plugin/layer
shell-string command construction that permits argument injection; spawn executable and argv separately and treat profile/version/package arguments as data
force-push, history rewrite, unrelated feature expansion, or writes outside Ran-sh/dsh-vision
validation: validate this Task Contract, resolve latest main SHA, create one task branch from main, open one Draft PR early, and keep it unmerged for ChatGPT review

inspect exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 `plugin --help`/supported lifecycle surface first. Implement install/update/status/uninstall strictly on top of supported official DSH commands; document any command mapping in tests/Result. Do not infer unsupported verbs

add a packaged npm bin entry so the public package supports `npx dsh-plugin-image-mind install`, `npx dsh-plugin-image-mind update`, `npx dsh-plugin-image-mind status`, and `npx dsh-plugin-image-mind uninstall`. The bin must be emitted into the published file set, be executable/portable, use ESM correctly, and show concise `--help`/unknown-command errors

support `--profile <name>` with default `web`; validate profile input as an argument rather than interpolated shell text. Support an explicit DSH version override only if needed for testing/forward compatibility, while the 0.2.0 default compatibility target remains exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2. Do not silently claim compatibility with untested Harness versions

define install semantics: use the official DSH plugin lifecycle to install/compose the exact dsh-plugin-image-mind version represented by the running CLI (0.2.0 in this release candidate), ensure the required @ran-sh/dsh-vision service is present through supported dependency/lifecycle behavior, and make a second install idempotent or a clear safe no-op rather than duplicating layers

define update semantics: `npx dsh-plugin-image-mind@latest update` must converge an installed profile to the exact CLI package version using official DSH lifecycle operations. Same-version update must be a safe no-op/success. Add deterministic tests for an older-installed-version -> current-version plan without changing repository package versions; use task-owned fixtures/stubs where a historical registry artifact would make the test unsafe or unavailable

define status semantics: without mutating the profile, report profile, Harness version/target, plugin installed/not-installed state, installed plugin version when discoverable, service presence/version when discoverable, and whether the running CLI version is newer/same/older where reliable. Provide a stable `--json` mode suitable for scripts; human mode must be concise. Status for a missing plugin is not an exception and must not write state

define uninstall semantics: use official DSH remove operations, be idempotent when already absent, and remove the service layer only when official composition/reference evidence proves it is no longer needed. If shared/referenced, retain it and report why. Never directly delete profile files/node_modules/store residues; upstream inert residue behavior remains an upstream Harness concern

implement a process-runner boundary that captures exit code/stdout/stderr safely, propagates meaningful DSH failures, works on Windows command resolution as well as POSIX, never uses shell=true unless proven unavoidable and safely bounded, and redacts credentials/private material from errors

add focused unit/integration tests covering argv construction, profile/default profile, help/unknown command, install idempotence, update same-version and older->current planning, status human/JSON for installed and absent states, uninstall absent/idempotent/shared-service retention, nonzero DSH errors, malformed/hostile profile inputs, version parsing, and secret/path redaction

acceptance_criteria: The packed dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.0 exposes a working npm bin such that the intended public UX is `npx dsh-plugin-image-mind install|update|status|uninstall`.
All mutating commands delegate to exact supported official DSH lifecycle operations and never directly edit Harness-owned state.
Install/update/uninstall are idempotent and status is read-only; uninstall preserves a shared vision service when still referenced.
`--profile` is supported safely with default web, process execution is injection-resistant/cross-platform, failures are meaningful and secret-safe, and `status --json` has a stable tested shape.
Packed-artifact CLI roundtrip passes in task-owned exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 state, including install -> status -> update -> boot/route smoke -> uninstall -> absent status.
CLI portability is evidenced on Linux, Windows and macOS at the level honestly supported by the exact rc.2 host; no untested platform is overclaimed.
README is concise and makes the four npx lifecycle commands the primary post-publication UX without claiming the unpublished package is currently available.

Both package versions remain 0.2.0, public package contents include only intended artifacts, full repo/package tests and publish dry-runs pass, and exact 0.2.0 registry checks remain EXPECTED_NOT_PUBLISHED.

Final PR-head CI including the macOS CLI lane is green, Result Contract v2 is validator-stamped, ACTIVE_TASK is deleted on the execution branch, and no publish/tag/release/real-Harness side effect occurs.
